phase_name: Rewrite roadmap-format.md as a generation contract

objectives.description: Full rewrite of roadmap-format.md into a generation contract

deviations.description: Write ## Authored vs. Generated with Class in {generated, authored-verbatim, authored-retained, measured-by-hand}
deviations.reason: ## Next needed a mixed class (generated Run-block skeleton + authored-retained rationale/why-this-order prose) that a single authored-retained label could not express; used 'mixed: generated skeleton + authored-retained prose' for that one row instead of forcing it into one of the four atomic labels.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added a mixed class for ## Next's two-part structure)*

deviations.description: Write ## Status Tokens precedence rule exactly as HOLD > IN FLIGHT > BLOCKED > PARTIAL > blocked:N[,M...] > ready with EXT-BLOCKED named as an authored annotation
deviations.reason: The plan's precedence list did not state where EXT-BLOCKED sits numerically. Placed it at precedence 5 (after PARTIAL, before blocked:/ready) so an authored external-blocker override is always checked before the dependency-derived fallback, matching Phase 5's test requirement that EXT-BLOCKED survive a regenerate.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — EXT-BLOCKED placed at precedence 5, checked before blocked:/ready)*
